title: Week 47 · 16–22 November 2026: Anthropic goes public, California sues OpenAI, AI attack on the EU
description: Period: 16–22 November 2026. Anthropic completes its IPO, California sues OpenAI over AI agents that got out of control, and the European Commission confirms a cyberattack carried out with an AI tool. Plus computer use in Gemini for Mac and Microsoft's own models.
